Privacy Policies

The design and architecture of Coral Log are based on a strict Privacy by Design principle. We understand that menstrual health information is highly sensitive, so we have built the application to ensure that your data belongs exclusively to you.

1. Data Collection and Storage (Offline-First)
Coral Log operates under a 100% autonomous (offline-first) approach. All the information you record, including but not limited to:
• Start and end dates of your menstrual cycles and bleeding days.
• Flow levels (minimum, light, moderate, high, heavy).
• Intensity of cramps.
• Calculated phases (menstrual, follicular, ovulation, luteal).
Is stored exclusively locally on your Android device's internal storage (isolated in the application's Sandbox environment). We do not use backend servers or cloud databases to save, process, or view this information.

2. Data Transmission and Telemetry
The collection, telemetry, or transmission of your personal or health data to third-party servers, external APIs, or market analysis tools is strictly prohibited and technically impossible. Coral Log does not require an internet connection for the full functioning of any of its features.

3. Backup and Retention
Since Coral Log lacks its own cloud infrastructure, the application does not perform automatic real-time synchronization between multiple devices. The retention and recovery of your data in case of loss, theft, formatting, or change of mobile device is the sole responsibility of the user and is subject to your operating system's backup settings (such as Google One Backup).

4. Single-User Environment and Confidentiality
The application is designed to operate in a single-user environment per device. We do not collect emails, real names, or require account creation or login, ensuring total anonymity from the developer.

Terms of Use

1. Nature of the Application and Platform
Coral Log is an informative and self-knowledge tool designed to record and visualize patterns in the menstrual cycle, providing historical averages based exclusively on the data entered by the user. The application is only available for devices with the Android operating system.

Medical Disclaimer: Coral Log is not a medical device, nor does it substitute for the diagnosis, treatment, or advice of a health professional. Phase predictions (menstrual, follicular, ovulation, and luteal), calculation of fertile windows, and symptom descriptions are based on standard medical formulas that may not reflect your exact biological reality. Do not use this application as a guaranteed contraceptive method.

2. Data Responsibility and Availability
The user is solely responsible for the accuracy of the data entered. Being a purely local storage system, the Coral Log development team has no access to your records and, therefore, is not responsible for any partial or total loss of information derived from accidental uninstalls, physical damage to the device, memory corruption, or operating system backup failures.

3. Personalization and System Use
The user is granted the freedom to adjust the interface through the selection of predefined color themes and typographic fonts. Likewise, the application will automatically detect the language (English or Spanish) and lighting preference (light or dark mode) of your device. The use of this software license is strictly personal and non-commercial.

4. Modifications to Policies and Terms
The development team, from Truco Simple, reserves the right to update these policies and terms in future versions of the application to reflect new features (e.g., future health analytics). Any changes will be notified through the update notes and will take effect at the time of installing the new version.
